name: hackathon
description: Explicit, time-boxed workflow skills for a proctored Codex hackathon: kickoff, decisions, checkpoints, delegation, submission.

interface.shortDescription: Spec in 20 minutes, decisions in writing, submit with a briefing.
interface.longDescription: Five explicitly invoked skills for a 180-minute proctored task: hk-kickoff (spec, stakeholder questions, timed plan), hk-decision (decision log for AI-free follow-up questions), hk-checkpoint (time-based scope control), hk-delegate (self-contained subagent dispatch), and hk-submit (audit, fresh verification, submission document, briefing). Builds on spec-first.
